title: Djinn of Rituals: Their Own Rituals (lore build)
summary: The Djinns of Rituals are Ritual tributes with no Ritual of their own, so this lore build pairs them with the Level 7 Rituals from their own booster sets: Divine Grace - Northwemko from Stardust Overdrive and Garlandolf, King of Destruction from Absolute Powerforce. Forbidden Ritual Art (2026) joins them because Djinn Releaser of Rituals appears in its artwork, and the Djinn of the Rituals page opens this same list.

summary.title: Starters & Enablers
points: The five legal Djinns of Rituals: Djinn Demolisher of Rituals, Djinn Presider of Rituals, Djinn Cursenchanter of Rituals, Djinn Disserere of Rituals, and Djinn Prognosticator of Rituals.
Divine Grace - Northwemko and Ritual of Grace, from Stardust Overdrive alongside Presider and Releaser.
Garlandolf, King of Destruction and Ritual of Destruction, from Absolute Powerforce alongside Cursenchanter, Disserere, and Prognosticator.
Forbidden Ritual Art, the newest card depicting Djinn Releaser of Rituals.

summary.title: Djinn Tribute Effects
points: Each Djinn can be banished from the GY as one of a Ritual Summon's tributes, granting its bonus effect to the Ritual Monster summoned with it.
Djinn Demolisher of Rituals (Level 3) makes the Ritual Monster untargetable by the opponent's card effects.

Djinn Disserere of Rituals (Level 1) makes the Ritual Monster unaffected by Trap effects, and Djinn Cursenchanter of Rituals (Level 4) negates the effects of face-up Synchro Monsters while the Ritual Monster stays face-up.

Djinn Presider of Rituals (Level 4) draws 1 card whenever the Ritual Monster destroys a monster by battle, and Djinn Prognosticator of Rituals (Level 3) makes the opponent discard 1 card whenever the Ritual Monster inflicts battle damage.

summary.title: Opening & Ritual Sequence
steps: Activate Ritual of Grace or Ritual of Destruction and Tribute two Djinns from your hand or field—such as a Level 4 Presider or Cursenchanter plus a Level 3 Demolisher or Prognosticator—to Ritual Summon Northwemko or Garlandolf with both Djinn effects active.

Because those Djinns are now in the GY, your next Ritual Summon banishes them directly from the GY as the entire Level 7 tribute requirement, stacking targeting immunity, Trap immunity, or draw power at zero hand cost.
Once a Ritual Monster is in the GY, activate Forbidden Ritual Art to Ritual Summon it from the GY by banishing monsters from your hand, field, or GY as the tribute.

summary.title: Ritual Bosses & Spells
points: Garlandolf, King of Destruction (2500 ATK, Level 7) destroys every other face-up monster on the field with DEF at or below its ATK when Ritual Summoned, gaining 100 ATK per monster destroyed.

Divine Grace - Northwemko (2700 ATK, Level 7) picks face-up cards on the field up to the number of monsters used for her Ritual Summon; while any of those cards stay on the field, she cannot be destroyed by card effects.
Ritual of Grace banishes itself from the GY to protect a Ritual Monster you control from being targeted by card effects this turn.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Djinn Releaser of Rituals is Forbidden in the TCG, and the Rank 3 and Rank 4 Musik Djinn Xyz Monsters belong to a separate Xyz series rather than the Djinn of Rituals engine.

main: As GY tribute, its Ritual Monster can't be targeted by them.
As GY tribute, its Ritual Monster draws on each kill.
As GY tribute, its Ritual Monster negates Synchro Monsters.
As GY tribute, its Ritual Monster is unaffected by Traps.
As GY tribute, its Ritual Monster makes them discard on a hit.
Level 7 Ritual: destroys every face-up monster with DEF at or below its ATK.
Level 7 Ritual: can't be destroyed by effects while its picked cards stay.
Ritual Spell for Northwemko; banishes to protect a Ritual Monster.
Newest: Ritual Summons from the GY by banishing tributes there.
